general.subtitle: Your profile, display currency, language and theme.

profile.title: Profile
profile.birthDateHint: Optional. Used by planning tools such as the retirement planner.

region.title: Region
region.currencyHint: Totals, charts and returns are converted at the latest exchange rate, history at each day's rate. Loans and account rows keep their own currency.

general.saveFailed: We couldn't save your settings. Please try again.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.subtitle: Read your net worth programmatically. Keys are private and scoped to your account.

create.title: Create a key
create.description: A key grants read-only access to your current net worth. Treat it like a password: never commit it or use it in browser code.
create.name: Name

revoke.title: Revoke “{name}”?
revoke.description: Requests using this key will be rejected immediately. This cannot be undone.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Send the key in the Authorization header. Keys in URLs are not accepted. Each key is limited to {limit} requests per minute. Amounts are in EUR; add ?currency=USD, GBP or CHF to convert them at the latest exchange rate.

newKey.title: Copy your new API key
newKey.description: This is the only time the key will be shown. Store it somewhere safe, such as a password manager or secret store.
